simple.meaning: גָּזֵל (gâzêl) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “robbery , or (concretely) plunder.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 4 times across Leviticus, Psalms, Isaiah, Ezekiel, beginning at Leviticus 5:21. Its contexts include land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גָּזֵל (H1498).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: גָּזֵל (gâzêl) / H1498 is traced through Leviticus 5:21, Psalms 62:11, Isaiah 61:8, Ezekiel 22:29 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H1498. gazel גָּזֵל noun [masculine] robbery — absolute גָּזֵל Leviticus 5:21 3 t. + Ezek 18:18 compare below; construct גֵּזֶל Eccl 5:7 ; Ezek 18:18 (but compare below); — robbery Leviticus 5:21 (P) Psa 62:11 (|| עשֶׁק ) Isa 61:8 ; = thing plundered , taken as plunder, as plunder, accusative of congnate meaning with verb Ezek 22:29 ( גָּזֵל גָּזַל ); figurative משפט גֵּזֶל = wresting of justice (compare Isa 10:2 ) Eccl 5:7 . — Ezek 18:18 has אָח גֵּזֶל , but ᵐ5 Co strike out אח ; read then גָּזֵל . — compare Lag BN 172 .
